74350   A person makes a choice for a lump sum or SP1

        1.    in writing to an office or

        2.    by telephone to a number

        which is specified in writing by the Secretary of State as accepting a notice2. A
        person must make a choice in writing when directed to do so by the Secretary of
        State3.
